name: Shiny Text
description: A band of light sweeps across the text, like light catching metal.

name: Gradient Text
description: Text filled with a flowing, seamlessly looping gradient. Optional animated border.

name: Blur Text
description: Words or letters come into focus from a blur, one after another. Click to replay.

name: Split Text
description: Letters (or words) rise into place one after another with a springy overshoot. Optional line mask for a pull-up reveal.

name: Decrypted Text
description: Characters scramble through random symbols, then lock into place one by one. Hover the lower lines to decode them again.

name: Typewriter
description: Types one or more strings, pauses, deletes and types the next, with a smoothly blinking cursor.

name: Rotating Text
description: Cycles through words with a per-letter staggered slide inside a pill that resizes to fit, or a blur flip.

name: Count Up
description: Numbers count to their target with easing, tabular digits, separators, decimals and prefixes. Changing the target animates from the current value.

name: Sliding Number
description: An odometer: each digit rolls vertically on a spring when the value changes, carrying past 9 like a real counter.

name: Glitch Text
description: Slices of the text jump sideways with red/cyan channel splits in short, violent bursts.

name: Fuzzy Text
description: Thin rows of the text jitter sideways every frame like a noisy signal; hover to crank up the fuzz.

name: Circular Text
description: Text set around a slowly rotating ring; hovering spins it faster.
code:
ui.add(CircularText::new("GLOWKIT • ANIMATED • RUST • ").center_text("✦"));
ui.add(CircularText::new("hover to slow down * ").on_hover(HoverSpin::SlowDown));

name: Scroll Velocity
description: Huge rows of text marquee in opposite directions forever; scroll over them to kick the speed (scrolling up reverses).

name: Wave Text
description: Letters bob on a travelling sine wave, optionally with a gradient riding the crest.
code:
ui.add(WaveText::new("Riding the wave").size(52.0));
ui.add(WaveText::new("with a gradient").colors(&theme.gradient));

name: Proximity Text
description: Letters near the pointer swell, thicken and shift color, nudging their neighbours aside.

name: True Focus
description: One word at a time snaps into focus inside animated corner brackets while the rest stay blurred.

name: Sparkles Text
description: Text with little four-pointed stars that pop in, twinkle and fade around it.

name: Morphing Text
description: Words melt into each other: the old one dissolves into a blur as the next condenses out of it.

name: Text Generate
description: A paragraph streams in word by word, each word fading out of a blur, like an AI response.

name: Highlight Text
description: Animated emphasis drawn onto a phrase: marker swipe, underline, box, hand-drawn circle or strike-through.

name: Colorful Text
description: Each letter takes a color from a palette; every few seconds they reshuffle in a little blur-and-bounce wave.

name: Gradual Spacing
description: Letters start squeezed together and spread out to their natural spacing as they fade in.

name: Text Roll
description: Letters roll up and out while copies roll in from below, staggered. Holds while hovered; great for menus.

name: Shuffle Text
description: Each letter is a little slot-machine reel that spins through random letters and lands on the real one.

name: Scroll Reveal
description: A paragraph whose words brighten progressively from faint to full, driven by time, your own progress value or its scroll position.
code:
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("When does a man die? ...").scroll_linked());
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("Driven by a slider").progress(progress));

name: Line Shadow Text
description: Bold text with an offset shadow made of diagonal stripes that keep sliding through it.

name: Falling Text
description: Click and the words drop under gravity, tumble, bounce and pile up; drag through the pile to shove them, click again to send them home.

name: Animated Underline
description: Link text whose underline draws in from the left on hover and slides out to the right when the pointer leaves.

name: Scramble Hover
description: Letters dissolve into flickering symbols while hovered and resolve back left to right when the pointer leaves.

name: Box Reveal
description: A solid box sweeps across each line and slides away, uncovering text that rises in behind it.
code:
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("Magic UI.").size(64.0));
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("UI library for egui").delay(0.2).size(24.0));

name: Curved Loop
description: A text marquee flowing endlessly along a curved path. Drag it to scrub; throw it and it keeps running that way.
code:
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Welcome to glowkit")
    .curve(80.0)
    .speed(80.0));
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Bend it like Rust")
    .curve(-40.0)
    .gradient(&palettes::MAGIC)
    .reverse(true));

name: Text Cursor
description: A trail of little text or emoji stamps pops out behind the pointer, wobbling and drifting as it fades. A ghost pointer draws loops when you are away.

name: Scroll Float
description: Letters float up out of the line, tall and squeezed at first, settling into shape one after another as the progress grows. Driven by time, a progress value or a scroll area.

name: ASCII Text
description: Big lettering redrawn as animated ASCII art: denser symbols where there is more ink, rippled by a flowing wave and tinted with a drifting gradient. The pointer bends it like a lens.

name: Scrambled Text
description: A paragraph whose letters dissolve into flickering symbols near the pointer and settle back into place after a moment.

name: Comic Text
description: Chunky comic-book lettering with a thick ink outline, a hard drop shadow and a halftone dot pattern, popping in with a springy twist.

name: Video Text
description: Huge letters that act as a window onto a moving scene (aurora, ocean, lava or plasma) flowing continuously across the whole word.

name: Text Reveal Card
description: Drag or hover across the card: left of a glowing divider, a hidden line of text shows through with twinkling stars.

name: Text Hover Effect
description: A huge outlined word; a radial gradient follows the pointer and lights the outline in color around it.

name: Pointer Highlight
description: A rectangle draws itself around a phrase while a pointer cursor glides to its corner, as if someone just highlighted it.
code: ui.add(PointerHighlight::new("The best way to grow is to ", "collaborate", "."));

name: Cover
description: Text in a box that turns into hyperspace on hover: streaking beams, sparkles, glowing corners and jittering text.

name: Number Pop In
description: Old digits sink away one by one; new ones rise from below, small and soft, overshoot the baseline and spring into place, staggered left to right.

name: Number Subtle Change
description: A counter that changes quietly: the old value drifts a few points away and blurs out as the new one drifts in, up for increases and down for decreases.

name: Text States Swap
description: A status line swaps its words with a tiny lift: the old text rises and blurs out, the new text rises into place from below.

name: Texts Reveal
description: Lines (or words) rise 12 points, un-blur and fade in on a long smooth curve, each a beat after the last; hiding is a quick fade.

name: Spinning Counter
description: Digits on little drums roll to the new value column by column, neighbours ghosting past; each lands with a pull-back and a springy snap past full size.

name: Thinking States
description: An AI status label with a soft highlight sweeping across muted text; each new state lifts the old words away and rises in.

name: Reasoning Stream
description: A card of agent reasoning that scrolls itself: every beat the text glides up a couple of lines on an ease-out, fading at the top and bottom, looping seamlessly.

name: Streaming Text
description: A reply streams in word by word, each word fading up out of a soft blur a beat after the last, with a caret riding the end.
code:
// feed it the text so far; only new words animate
ui.add(StreamText::new(&reply).width(380.0));

name: Flip Letters
description: Letters that roll over like a split-flap as the pointer passes, rippling to their neighbours with a springy overshoot.

name: Text Reel
description: A vertical stream of words under a fixed label; scroll or drag to inject momentum, reverse it, and let it ease back to cruising.

name: Ink Reveal
description: Every word starts faint and inks in as the scroll reaches it, with a soft leading edge; accented words light up with a highlighter swept behind them.

name: Petal Dissolve
description: A word erodes into tumbling red and white petals, then time runs backwards and every petal flies home to rebuild it.

name: Molten Text
description: A headline filled with churning molten metal: domain-warped lava, bevelled letter edges and a heat glow.

name: Chrome Text
description: Liquid chrome lettering: a sky-horizon-ground environment reflected in bevelled type, rippling, with a sweeping glint.

name: Grain Text
description: A headline filled with a slow drifting gradient of light under real per-pixel film grain.

name: Dither Text
description: A headline printed in four inks through an ordered-dither screen, with a band of light sweeping across it.

name: Aurora
description: Flowing curtains of northern light that drift and shimmer, fading into the background.

name: Particles
description: Drifting particles with depth, optional constellation links and pointer repulsion.

name: Squares Grid
description: An endlessly scrolling grid; the hovered square fills in and fades as you move on.

name: Dot Grid
description: A field of dots that bulges away from the pointer and springs back with a wobble. Click for a shockwave.

name: Grid Pattern
description: Thin grid lines with squares fading in and out at random, a hover highlight and an optional skew.

name: Retro Grid
description: A perspective grid floor scrolling toward the viewer, fading at the horizon.

name: Flickering Grid
description: A grid of tiny squares each flickering to random opacities, like a quiet LED panel.

name: Meteors
description: Meteor streaks with glowing heads and fading tails falling diagonally at random speeds.

name: Shooting Stars
description: Twinkling stars with shooting stars streaking across every couple of seconds.

name: Background Beams
description: Faint curved paths sweeping across the area with pulses of colored light racing along them.

name: Wavy Background
description: Thick, blurred ribbons of color undulating like slow ocean waves.

name: Waves
description: Dozens of thin lines warped by flowing noise; the pointer drags them and they spring back.

name: Threads
description: Fine threads fanning out from a bundle into flowing, rippling strands that lean toward the pointer.

name: Silk
description: Smooth, undulating folds of shaded silk with soft specular highlights.

name: Iridescence
description: An oily, iridescent rainbow film that swirls and shifts; the pointer stirs it.

name: Swirl
description: Psychedelic paint swirling into a slowly spinning vortex with marbled bands.

name: Liquid Metal
description: Rippling liquid chrome with flowing reflections; the pointer sends ripples through it.

name: Plasma
description: Classic demoscene plasma: interfering sine fields mapped to a glowing, looping palette.

name: Lightning
description: A crackling bolt with a white-hot core, wide glow and flickering branches.

name: Orb
description: A glowing ring of colored light with a breathing edge that ripples and spins faster on hover.

name: Warp Speed
description: Hyperspace star streaks rushing toward the viewer. Press and hold to engage warp.

name: Galaxy
description: A slowly rotating spiral galaxy with a bright core and colorful arms. Stars scatter from the pointer.

name: Letter Glitch
description: A wall of monospace letters constantly glitching to new characters and colors, with a vignette.

name: Matrix Rain
description: Columns of glyphs raining down with bright heads and fading trails.

name: Ripple
description: Concentric circles breathing in a staggered wave, fading toward the bottom.

name: Spotlight
description: Volumetric light rays fanning down from above, swaying and shimmering, leaning toward the pointer.

name: Lamp
description: A bright bar of light widening into view and casting a fan of colored light upward.

name: Vortex
description: Hundreds of glowing particles swirling into a vortex with short colorful trails.

name: Gradient Blobs
description: Big soft blobs of color drifting and blending like a lava lamp, one following the pointer.

name: Mesh Gradient
description: A smoothly animated four-color mesh gradient with organic swirl and distortion.

name: Snowfall
description: Gently falling snow with depth: distant flakes small and slow, near ones big and swaying.

name: Grain Noise
description: Animated film grain overlay that gives gradients an analog texture (right half).

name: Background Boxes
description: A skewed isometric grid of boxes that light up in random colors under the pointer.

name: Beams
description: Tall columns of soft light with luminous texture flowing down them; rotate for a diagonal look.

name: Hex Grid
description: A honeycomb of hexagons with random pulses, a rolling wave of light and a pointer glow.

name: Liquid Ether
description: A real-time fluid simulation: moving the pointer stirs glowing eddies of color that curl, mix and slowly fade. A ghost pointer keeps it alive.

name: Grid Scan
description: A wireframe grid tunnel receding into the distance, swept by a glowing scan frame that lights up the lines it passes. The view leans toward the pointer.

name: Prismatic Burst
description: Rays of rainbow light bursting from the center, rotating, flickering and breathing, with shock rings rippling outward.

name: Grid Motion
description: A tilted wall of tiles whose rows slide in opposite directions as the pointer moves, each with its own lag, for a deep parallax feel.

name: Laser Flow
description: A laser beam falls from the top and splashes across a surface, wrapped in luminous fog that curls outward and up.

name: Metallic Paint
description: A shape or logo filled with flowing liquid metal: rippling chrome bands, a bevelled rim and a highlight that follows the pointer.

name: Background Lines
description: Long flowing curves sweep across the area, drawing themselves in, lingering and erasing again, each on its own rhythm and in its own color.

name: Dotted Map
description: A world map drawn as a grid of dots, with glowing arcs flying between cities one after another and markers rippling where they land.

name: Meta Balls
description: Organic blobs that merge and split like liquid, colored by the dominant blob; one follows the pointer.
code:
ui.add(MetaBalls::new().count(9));
// behind other content: MetaBalls::new().paint_at(ui, rect, pointer_pos)

name: Ball Pit
description: Glossy balls with gravity, collisions and bounce; the pointer shoves them around and an invisible hand stirs them when idle.

name: Ripple Grid
description: Grid lines rippling with waves from the center and the pointer, crests lit in the accent color.

name: Dark Veil
description: A dark, slowly flowing veil of tinted light, like light through smoke.

name: Color Bends
description: Bands of vivid color that bend and flow, leaning toward the pointer.

name: Gradient Blinds
description: Venetian-blind slats of flowing gradient, each lit across its width, with a spotlight that follows the pointer.

name: Pixel Blast / Dither
description: Animated noise or waves quantized with a 4x4 Bayer ordered dither into pixels, dots or diamonds; ripples burst from the pointer.

name: Faulty Terminal
description: A glitchy green CRT: flickering glyphs under a brightness wave, scanlines, rolling interference and row glitches.

name: Fluted Glass
description: A picture behind reeded glass: each rib is its own lens holding a squeezed slice of the image, smeared into spikes, bending harder near the pointer.

name: Halftone Logo
description: A logo built from a rotated halftone dot screen with a wave of ink rolling through the dots.

name: Warp Grid
description: A fine grid that bends into a gravity well around a dark sphere under the pointer, glowing where it is pulled hardest.

name: Tornado
description: A strand vortex: hundreds of helical lines pinch into a waist and flare into a swirling floor, with motes and comets riding the funnel; the pointer parts the strands.

name: Accretion Disc
description: A black hole: thousands of particles orbit an occluding core along glowing log-spiral lanes, with faint polar jets. Drag to orbit the camera.

name: Light Cables
description: A bundle of glowing fibre cables rising from a wide fan, folding through one bend into a bright point, with light pulses running up them; the cables lean toward the pointer.

name: Wire Terrain
description: An endless flight down a wireframe valley toward a banded horizon sun, with hidden-line ridges; the pointer steers the camera.

name: Ribbon Glow
description: Layered ribbons of light sweep across the frame, twisting as they go and bending into a bright swirl around the pointer.

name: Matrix Junction
description: Glowing beams converge from every edge on a bright node that throws jittered lightning arcs toward the pointer.

name: Cloud Sky
description: An animated sky: cumulus clouds drift on two parallax layers under a cirrus veil, with a low sun glow; the pointer turns the wind. Dusk palette on dark themes.

name: Still Sunset Meadow
description: A ground-level voxel meadow at sunset: square sun, drifting block clouds, a blocky treeline and swaying cube grass and pixel flowers with a soft out-of-focus foreground.

name: Glimmer Vale
description: A night meadow of rolling hills made of twinkling peach-to-violet glitter under a periwinkle sky, with blooming crests and soft daisies drifting in the foreground.

name: Shimmer Button
description: A dark pill with a spark of light racing around its border and an inner glow that rises on hover.

name: Shiny Button
description: A subtle surface button whose label and border catch a band of light sweeping across.

name: Rainbow Button
description: A high-contrast button with a flowing rainbow border and a blurred rainbow glow pooled beneath it.

name: Pulsating Button
description: A solid call-to-action that sends soft rings of color pulsing outward like a heartbeat.

name: Ripple Button
description: Material-style ink ripples spread from wherever you click, clipped to the button's rounded shape.

name: Interactive Hover Button
description: A dot beside the label swells to fill the pill on hover while a new label and arrow slide in.
code:
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Book a demo"));
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Hover me").hover_label("Let's go"));

name: Moving Border
description: A glowing blob of light endlessly orbits the button's thin border.

name: Hover Border Gradient
description: A highlight circles the pill's border; on hover the light spreads over the whole border in color.

name: Star Border
description: Two stars of light glide along the top and bottom edges in opposite directions.

name: Magnetic Button
description: The button is pulled toward the pointer as it approaches and springs back when it leaves.

name: Glow Button
description: A glossy gradient pill floating on a breathing pool of its own colored light; it lifts on hover.

name: Neon Button
description: An outlined neon tube with glowing text that occasionally flickers, and floods with light on hover.

name: Liquid Fill Button
description: Liquid with a wavy surface rises inside the outline on hover, flipping the label color as it passes.

name: Stateful Button
description: Idle, then a spinner while loading, then a drawn check mark on success, resizing smoothly between states.

name: Animated Subscribe Button
description: A toggle that slides between two labels, gaining a check mark and a new color when active.

name: Copy Button
description: Copies text to the clipboard; the copy icon morphs into a check mark, then back.
code:
ui.add(CopyButton::new("cargo add glowkit"));
ui.add(CopyButton::new("npm i glowkit").label("Copy"));

name: Particle Burst Button
description: Click to burst confetti, sparkles and dots out of the button (hold to keep spraying).

name: 3D Push Button
description: A chunky key you physically push: it pops up on hover and sinks on press with a bouncy spring.

name: Pixel Button
description: A retro 8-bit button with stair-stepped corners, a chunky bevel and a pixel drop shadow.

name: Gradient Outline Button
description: A transparent button outlined by a rotating gradient that floods the button on hover.

name: Arrow Slide Button
description: On hover the label nudges aside and the arrow chip shoots its arrow out while a new one slides in.

name: Glass Icons
description: Frosted glass tiles floating over tilted, vividly colored backplates; hover swings the plate and lifts the glass.

name: Script Copy Button
description: An install command with package-manager tabs and a copy button whose clipboard morphs into a check with a 'Copied!' bubble.

name: Animated Theme Toggler
description: A sun that morphs into a crescent moon; switching sweeps a circular reveal of the new theme across the area.

name: Unfurl
description: A parchment button that levitates, tips into a rolled scroll and drops its bottom roller; the charter inks itself in line by line and a wax seal stamps it shut.

name: Liquid Glass Button
description: Glass pills that blur and bend what is behind them like a thick lens, with rim highlights chasing the pointer.

name: Venom Button
description: A glossy black goo button: liquid strands stretch out to wrap a cartoon glove cursor when it comes close, then snap back with a wobble when you pull away.

name: Spider Button
description: A glossy red pill with corner cobwebs that shoots sagging web lines at the pointer, splats a web on click and snaps back when you pull away.

name: Velour Bolster
description: A velvet pill button that inflates into a soft cushion under the pointer, with grazing-angle sheen; it jiggles as you move, dents when pressed and settles flat.

name: Expanding Arrow Button
description: A dark pill with a bright arrow block that swallows the button on hover, its dotted chevron turning into a marching train.
code:
if ui.add(ExpandingArrowButton::new("Book a demo")).clicked() { /* go */ }
ui.add(ExpandingArrowButton::new("Get started").accent(egui::Color32::from_rgb(125, 211, 252)));

name: Border Beam
description: A comet of light travels around the border, fading from one color to another along its tail.

name: Shine Border
description: A band of multi-colored light drifts diagonally around the card's border.

name: Magic Card
description: A spotlight follows the pointer inside the card while the border lights up in a gradient around it.

name: Spotlight Card
description: A dark card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, optionally revealing a dot grid.

name: Tilt Card
description: The card tilts in 3D toward the pointer with real perspective, a moving glare and parallax content.

name: Glare Card
description: A diagonal streak of glare sweeps across the card on hover, with a soft sheen under the pointer.

name: Neon Gradient Card
description: A card wrapped in an animated two-tone gradient border that bleeds a big neon glow around it.

name: Glowing Border Card
description: The border lights up in a multi-color arc on the side facing the pointer, gliding around as it moves.

name: Encrypted Card
description: Scrambled characters are revealed over a glowing gradient in a circle around the pointer.

name: Pixel Card
description: Shimmering pixels fill the card on hover, spreading out from the center.

name: Glass Card
description: A frosted-glass card with a translucent fill, a light-catching rim and a soft shadow.

name: Wobble Card
description: A bold card wobbles toward the pointer on a springy band while its content drifts the other way.

name: Card Hover Effect
description: A soft highlight slab slides between cards in a grid, following the pointer.

name: Hover Lift Card
description: The card rises toward you on hover: a deeper shadow, an accent glow and a warmer border.

name: Focus Cards
description: The hovered card stays in focus while the others shrink back, dim and haze over.

name: Electric Border
description: A jittery, crackling border of electricity with layered glow.

name: Animated Gradient Border
description: A conic gradient keeps rotating around the border, optionally with a matching glow.

name: Marching Border
description: Dashes march around the border like a selection marquee or a drop zone.

name: Magic Bento
description: A bento grid where a spotlight follows the pointer and lights card borders; the hovered card tilts and sparkles with particles.

name: Chroma Grid
description: Profile tiles rendered in grayscale, with a circle of full color that follows the pointer across the grid.

name: Profile Card
description: A holographic trading-card profile that tilts toward the pointer while rainbow foil and a glare slide across it.

name: Glass Surface
description: A refracting glass panel: the backdrop bends and compresses toward its rim with color fringes and specular edges.

name: Fluid Glass
description: A liquid glass lens that glides after the pointer, magnifying and bending everything beneath it with rainbow edges.

name: Decay Card
description: A poster card whose picture tears and ripples with turbulence as the pointer moves over it, then slowly heals.

name: Pixel Transition
description: A card that swaps to its second face through a pixel dissolve: squares pop in at random, then away again.

name: Direction Aware Hover
description: A card whose caption overlay slides in from the edge the pointer entered through, and leaves the way it exits.

name: Glowing Stars Card
description: A card with a grid of tiny stars where random ones softly glow; more of them light up on hover.
code: ui.add(GlowingStarsCard::new("Next-gen rendering", "Crisp, animated UI on every platform."));

name: Canvas Reveal Effect
description: On hover a flickering dot-matrix ripples out from the center of the card while the icon lifts and the title appears.

name: 3D Pin
description: A card that tilts back in perspective on hover while a pin rises from its center with a label and pulsing rings.

name: Split Showcase
description: Two partner cards joined into one capsule by a dotted seam; the hovered half springs outward and rounds its inner corners.

name: Crumple Reveal
description: Balls of screwed-up paper on a desk; click one and it smooths out into the letter or photo it was, still faintly creased.

name: Elastic Frame
description: A rounded frame drawn as an elastic string: bring the pointer to an edge and it plucks outward into a glowing veil, then springs back with a wobble.

name: Card Bookmark
description: Cards cut like bookmarks with silky wave-ribbon art; the active one fills with its colour, lifts and glows while the others wait in the dark.

name: Holo Card
description: A holographic foil card that tilts toward the pointer in 3D, its thin-film sheen sliding with the angle.

name: Quote Deck
description: A testimonial deck fanned across the width: the focused quote upright, the rest leaning away, shrinking and dimming.
code:
let quotes = vec![Quote::new("Every detail was argued for.", "Mira Okafor", "Design lead", "Northwind"), /* ... */];
ui.add(QuoteDeck::new(&quotes).lean(1.0).autoplay(3.6));

name: Story Deck
description: Customer stories beside a deck of portrait cards you can throw; autoplay runs with a progress ring round the next button.
code:
let stories = vec![Story::new("We shipped in half the time.", "Ana Ruiz", "CTO, Brightline", "2x", "faster releases"), /* ... */];
ui.add(StoryDeck::new(&stories).autoplay(5.0));

name: Project Folder
description: A folder with pastel pages peeking out: hover and they fan up on rippling springs, press and they slide out into a row as the frosted front sinks.

name: Wallet Card
description: A wallet card whose balance rolls like an odometer when it changes, folds into dots behind the eye toggle, and carries a gain or loss pill that flips with it.
code:
let mut balance = 12_480.32;
ui.add(WalletCard::new(&mut balance).name("Main Wallet"));

name: Click Spark
description: Lines of light burst outward from every click. Wraps any area without stealing its clicks.

name: Click Ripple
description: Concentric rings ripple out from each click like a drop hitting water.

name: Pointer Trail
description: A glowing comet tail chases the pointer and shrinks away when it stops.

name: Ribbons
description: Silky ribbons chase the pointer on springs of different stiffness, weaving around each other.

name: Pixel Trail
description: Cells of an invisible grid light up under the pointer and fade out, leaving a pixelated trail.

name: Card Trail
description: Moving the pointer drops a trail of cards that pop in, tilt and shrink away (image trail).

name: Blob Cursor
description: Gooey blobs chase the pointer with growing lag and melt into each other like liquid.

name: Smooth Cursor
description: A custom cursor glides after the pointer on a spring, turning to face its direction of travel.

name: Following Pointer
description: A collaborator-style pointer with a name tag that trails the cursor over a card.
code:
let card = ui.add(my_card).rect;
FollowingPointer::new("Ada Lovelace").color(hex("#0EA5E9")).show(ui, card);

name: Crosshair
description: Hairlines track the pointer across the area, with an intersection ring and live coordinates.

name: Target Cursor
description: Spinning corner brackets follow the pointer and snap around whatever target it hovers.

name: Magnet
description: Wraps any content and pulls it toward a nearby pointer, springing back when it leaves.

name: Confetti
description: Confetti bursts from a point, tumbles in 3D and flutters down. Fire it from code or on click.

name: Fireworks
description: Rockets streak up and burst into glowing, falling sparks. Click to launch your own.

name: Sticker Peel
description: A die-cut sticker you drag to peel: the corner folds back along a crease, showing its paper back and a curl shadow.

name: Magnet Lines
description: A grid of short lines that all swivel to point at the pointer, glowing in the accent color nearby.

name: Shape Blur
description: Soft, out-of-focus outlines that snap into crisp focus wherever the pointer gets close.

name: Lens
description: A magnifying glass over any painted scene: the content is re-painted larger inside a glassy circular lens.

name: Mask Reveal
description: A circular mask follows the pointer and reveals an alternate version of the content underneath; it swells on hover.

name: Animated Tooltip
description: Overlapping avatars; the hovered one lifts and a name tooltip pops above it, swinging with the pointer on a loose spring.
code:
let team = [Person::new("Sarah Chen", "Product Designer", hex("#8B5CF6"), hex("#EC4899")), /* ... */];
ui.add(AnimatedTooltip::new(&team));

name: Scratch To Reveal
description: A shimmering foil you scratch away with the pointer; past 50% the rest dissolves and it reports `revealed`. Self-scratches when idle.

name: Compare Slider
description: Before / after comparison of two painted scenes with a draggable divider and grab handle; sweeps on its own when idle.

name: Hover Image List
description: Big project titles; hovering one summons a photo that trails the pointer on a spring, tilting as it moves and sliding to the next image.

name: Ink Trail
description: A surface the cursor paints into: a glowing trail that drifts on a slow noise current and fades, like an ember on dark themes and wet ink on light ones.

name: Dither Lens
description: A photograph that turns into an ordered-dither print inside a ragged, flickering zone that follows the pointer.

name: Mosaic Trail
description: A field of tiny greyscale thumbnails that swell and bloom into colour along the pointer's path, then shrink back to dots.

name: Cursor Ring Field
description: A field of scattered capsules lit by a soft ring trailing the pointer: capsules on the ring brighten, turn and get pushed outward, then drift back.

name: Fluid Trail
description: The pointer stirs a small real-time fluid simulation, leaving glowing, color-cycling dye that curls and fades behind it.

name: Hover Image Reveal
description: A list of large names; hovering a row floats an image window that follows the pointer on a spring, tilts with its speed and swaps image per row.

name: Card Stack
description: A deck of photos that fans out as you reach it: hover draws a card up, click flips it into the middle.

name: ASCII Wake
description: A cube drawn in ink dots; the pointer drags a wake of characters through it that cools back to dots, and a press sends a ring out.

name: Wake Slider
description: A range made of thin bars with no thumb; drag fast and the bars you sweep past spring up in a wake behind the hand.

name: Folding Bill
description: A banknote simulated as cloth: grab it, drag it and fold it over itself; plain or with an engraved print.

name: Heat Map
description: Gray dots that melt into a glowing heat map under your cursor; press for the next shape.

name: Generate
description: Press Generate and an image resolves under frosted glass, broad shapes first.

name: Image Accordion
description: Hover a photo strip and it opens wide while its neighbours give way around it.

name: Magnetic Select
description: Press an option and it swells into an iridescent orb as the rest are pushed out of its way.

name: Checklist
description: Tick a task and the box pops full, the check draws itself in and the words strike out.
code:
let mut tasks = vec![TodoItem::new("Water the ferns"), TodoItem::new("Reply to Ana")];
ui.add(TaskChecklist::new(&mut tasks).bounce(50.0).corner(20.0).box_size(18.0));

name: Liquid Toggle
description: A switch whose droplet stretches as it slides across the track and snaps round at the end.
code:
let mut on = false;
ui.add(LiquidToggle::new(&mut on).speed(50.0).stretch(36.0));

name: Now Playing
description: A now-playing bar that opens into a full player and folds back as one piece.

name: Slosh Slider
description: A slider whose fill has weight: drag fast and the liquid sloshes past the handle before settling.

name: Stacked Bars
description: A month of visits as stacked bars: run along them and one day is ringed while a tooltip glides beside it; Day / Week regrows the bars.

name: Emoji Reactions
description: Press the button and the message turns into a pill of emoji; pick one and it flies down to its chip as the count rolls up.

name: Voice Note
description: Hold to record a waveform, slide left to bin it, let go to play it back.

name: Time Scrubber
description: Drag the ruler to set a time; fling it and it coasts with momentum to the nearest step.

name: Label Input
description: A field whose label rests inside like a placeholder and lifts into the top edge, opening a notch in the outline, when you focus it.

name: Step Player
description: Press play and each step fills as a bar, then eases on to the next dot.

name: Glass Bubble
description: Drag a ball of glass over a picture: it magnifies the middle, bends the rim and splits the colours at the edge.

name: Slide to Confirm
description: Push the handle across; past the mark it takes over, finishes itself and turns into a check.

name: Pull to Refresh
description: Pull the card down and it stretches while a ring of dots fills in; let go past the line to refresh.

name: Escape Button
description: A button that slides away from your cursor a few times, and then gives up.

name: Create Menu
description: Press the pill and it pours open into the create menu it was all along, items rising in one by one.

name: Slingshot
description: Pull the ball back: the band stretches, locks and trembles at its limit; let go and it flies, bounces off the walls and comes home.

name: Asset Swap
description: Flip the arrow to reverse the swap on a bouncy spring; tap a coin to pick another asset.

name: Like
description: Press the heart: it pops with a burst while the count rolls up a digit.

name: Eye Tracker
description: Two eyes on a soft cube turn to follow your cursor around the block, and blink now and then.

name: Todo Tower
description: A to-do list stacked like bricks; tick one off and it slides out while the rest drop into the gap.
code: ui.add(TodoTower::new(["Water the plants", "Ship the release", "Call the bank"]).gravity(0.5));

name: Action Node
description: An automation step card with its controls folded into the corner; hover and they fan out one by one.

name: Assignees
description: Assign people from a list and their faces stack up in the pill above it.

name: Palette
description: A set of colours that go together; press for a new palette and it washes across, swatch by swatch.

name: Dragging Ball
description: A ball you grab: it swells under the pointer, squeezes as you hold it and wobbles home when you let go.

name: Notification Badge
description: A count badge slides out of the bell's shoulder, swells past full size on a springy curve and sharpens; it ducks away quickly when cleared.

name: Menu Dropdown
description: A dropdown opens from its top edge, scaling up from 97% while fading in on a long smooth curve, and closes faster than it opened.

name: Dropdown Menu Morph
description: A round plus button stretches into the menu it opens on a springy curve; the plus spins away as the rows slide in, and closing tucks it back with a small nudge.

name: Modal Open Close
description: A dialog pops in from 96% while fading on a long smooth curve, and leaves in about half the time.
code:
ui.add(PopModal::new(open)
    .title("Delete project?")
    .body("This removes the project and its files for everyone.")
    .actions("Cancel", "Delete"));

name: Panel Reveal
description: A panel rises out of a clipped edge below its trigger, sliding up from half its height while it sharpens and fades in.

name: Icon Swap
description: An icon button swaps icons in place: the old one shrinks to a quarter, blurs and fades while the new one grows out of the same spot.
code:
ui.add(SwapIcon::new(&mut open, SwapIconPair::MenuClose));
ui.add(SwapIcon::new(&mut playing, SwapIconPair::PlayPause).duration(0.25));

name: Success Check
description: A green disc bobs up on a springy curve, spinning back from an angle as it sharpens out of a heavy blur, and its check draws itself a beat later.

name: Avatar Group Hover
description: Overlapping avatars lift toward the pointer: the hovered face rises and grows, its neighbours rise less and less, and they drop back with a quick springy bounce.

name: Error State Shake
description: On a failed submit the field shakes with decaying swings, its outline turns red and a message fades in, then both ease back to neutral.
code: ui.add(ShakeField::new(&mut email).error("Please enter a valid email.").attempt(attempts));

name: Input Clear With Dissolve
description: Pressing clear dissolves the query: the characters drift down and break into dust from the button outward, a soft haze blooms and the placeholder fades back.

name: Skeleton Loader And Reveal
description: A skeleton row breathes while it waits, then the real avatar and text fade up out of a slight blur as the skeleton melts away.

name: Tooltip Open Close
description: One tooltip shared by a row of buttons: it fades and grows in after a short delay, then glides and resizes between neighbours instead of blinking.

name: Toast Open Close
description: A toast rises 16 points into place, growing from 97% and un-blurring on a long smooth curve; it leaves the way it came, a little quicker.

name: Learn More Hover
description: On hover the chevron leans forward: it nudges right while its arms splay open, optionally growing a shaft into an arrow.

name: Banner Stacking
description: New banners rise in at the front while the others step back, smaller, dimmer and softer, peeking out above; the stack fans out into a list on hover.

name: Checkbox Check
description: The box fills in quickly, then the tick draws itself end to end on a long smooth curve; unchecking erases it fast.

name: Matrix Dot Loader
description: Tiny 4 x 4 dot matrices that flash dot by dot in scan, twinkle, orbit and pulse patterns.

name: Toggle
description: A switch whose pill thumb double-bounces: it overshoots the far end, swings back a hair and settles while the track flips color instantly.

name: Live Island
description: A black pill at the top of the screen that springs open into a live activity card and stretches to show notices.

name: Preview Menu
description: Touch and hold a photo: the grid frosts over, the photo springs into a large preview and a menu unfolds; slide onto an action and let go.

name: Reorder List
description: Drag a row by its grip: it lifts with a shadow, follows the finger with rubber-banded ends, and the other rows spring out of its way.
code:
let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Inbox", "12 messages"), TouchRow::new("Today", "")];
ui.add(ReorderList::new(&mut rows).bounce(40.0).lift(50.0));

name: Swipe Actions
description: Mail rows that slide to reveal Flag, Delete and Pin; over-drag rubber-bands, and a long swipe stretches Delete across the row and collapses it.
code:
let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Maya Chen", "Dinner on Friday?")];
ui.add(SwipeActions::new(&mut rows).full_swipe(true).resistance(50.0));

name: Selection List
description: Tap Select: rows slide aside in a cascade for round checkboxes, a floating toolbar rises, and a sweep down the checkbox column selects a run.
code:
let mut notes = vec![TouchRow::new("Groceries", "Milk, eggs, bread")];
ui.add(SelectionList::new(&mut notes).title("Notes").cascade(40.0));

name: Search Reveal
description: A search field tucked above a list: pull down and it unfolds, stop halfway and it snaps; the list flicks with momentum and rubber-bands at both ends.

name: Swipe Image Viewer
description: A photo grid that grows into a full-screen viewer: swipe to page with rubber-banded edges, double-tap to zoom, drag down to fling it home.

name: Tear Ticket
description: A train ticket whose stub tears off like paper: the perforation gives hole by hole, the corner peels, and a freed stub flutters away before a new one prints.

name: Meniscus
description: A drop of liquid glass that pulls free of its dock and melts into whatever it touches, refracting and colour-fringing the pool beneath; tap to frost it.
code: ui.add(Meniscus::new("Lido, four o'clock", "Pool floor, lane four, clear glass"));

name: Plush Tile
description: An app-icon tile covered in thousands of short combed strands that carry a mark in the pile; the fur parts under the pointer and stirs in a breeze.

name: Arc Picker
description: Options sit on the rim of a big wheel, turned to follow the curve; roll it and the chosen one lights up between springy brackets.

name: Wheel Picker
description: An iOS-style drum picker: columns roll under the finger, rows tip away toward the rim and click into a raised middle band.

name: Sortable Stack
description: Grab a task by its grip: it lifts off the stack while the others glide out of its way, and settles into its new slot when dropped.
code: ui.add(SortableStack::new(&mut tasks).heading("In the studio", "Make room for what matters."));

name: Card Dealer
description: A deck deals cards that arc into a fanned hand, flipping face up in flight; sort, shuffle and collect send every card gliding on its own springs.

name: Bloom Menu
description: A Create pill blooms into a grid of actions: its box morphs open, the label glides into the title, the plus turns into the close cross and tiles pop in.

name: Expandable Action Bar
description: An icon toolbar that ripples open into labelled actions with keyboard hints; badges ride along and one highlight glides between actions.

name: Expandable Control
description: Round icon buttons that spring open into labelled pills, and chips that grow a remove cross when picked.

name: Morphing Search
description: A frosted search bar floating over a gallery rises into a panel of recent searches when focused, rows sliding in under a gliding highlight.

name: Bouncy Accordion
description: Rows share one rounded block until one opens: it breaks away into its own card, gaps and corners springing around it as its text drops in with a bounce.

name: Overflow Actions
description: A pill of actions with a round more button: press it and the hidden actions slide out one by one as the pill stretches and the dots fold into a cross.

name: Swipeable List
description: Swipe a row left to slide it over snooze and delete; fling it and it flies off while the rows below spring up to close the gap.

name: Dock
description: A macOS-style dock: icons magnify around the pointer, show a label and bounce when clicked.

name: Marquee
description: Infinite scrolling strips of any content with faded edges; hover to pause, reverse for variety.

name: Animated List
description: Items pop in one after another, newest on top, pushing older ones down: a live notification feed.

name: Stack
description: A draggable card stack: fling the top card away and it tucks itself in at the back.

name: Card Swap
description: A skewed 3D stack that cycles: the front card drops away and reappears at the back.

name: Bounce Cards
description: A fan of cards bounces in one by one; hovering straightens a card and pushes its neighbors aside.

name: Carousel
description: Drag or swipe between items that snap into place on a spring; neighbors peek in and dots track position.

name: Ring Carousel
description: Cards on a rotating 3D ring with real perspective. Drag to spin; it coasts and drifts when idle.

name: Folder
description: A folder that opens on click: the flap tilts down, papers fan out and lean toward the pointer.

name: Elastic Slider
description: Drag past either end and the track stretches like rubber, then snaps back with a wobble.

name: Stepper
description: A multi-step flow with animated indicators, sliding step content and a height that springs to fit.

name: Animated Tabs
description: A highlight springs between tabs, stretching as it travels; a softer hover highlight follows the pointer.

name: Expandable Card
description: Compact cards grow in place into a detail panel over a dimmed backdrop, and shrink back on close.

name: Flowing Menu
description: Hovering a row floods it with a contrasting band, entering from the pointer's side, carrying a marquee.

name: Gooey Nav
description: The active pill slides to the clicked item while colorful particles burst out and melt back in.

name: Orbiting Circles
description: Icons circle a center on concentric rings, each ring with its own speed and direction.

name: Animated Beam
description: Glowing gradient pulses travel along curved paths between nodes: data flowing through a system.

name: Infinite Scroll
description: An endless, wrapping vertical list: scroll or drag with inertia, or let it drift. Edges fade out.

name: Masonry
description: A masonry grid whose tiles glide to their new places on springs whenever the layout changes.

name: Presence & Transitions
description: Animate content in and out on a spring (fade, slide, scale, pop), and switch panels with transitions.

name: Animated Content
description: Wrap anything and it slides, scales and fades into place as it scrolls into view.

name: Fade Content
description: Content starts soft, ghosted and transparent, then sharpens into focus when it scrolls into view.

name: Scroll Stack
description: Cards pin near the top as you scroll and pile into a stack, each one shrinking back under the next.

name: Gradual Blur
description: A progressive blur at the edge of a scroller: content softens and fades in steps as it leaves.

name: Apple Cards Carousel
description: Tall full-bleed image cards in a scrolling row; clicking one morphs it into a large detail dialog.

name: Container Scroll
description: A device mockup tilted back like an opening laptop lid rotates flat as it scrolls into view.

name: Hero Parallax
description: Rows of product tiles start tilted and faded in 3D, then rotate flat and slide in opposite directions as you scroll.
code:
let products: Vec<_> = names.iter().map(|n| ParallaxProduct::new(*n)).collect();
ui.add(HeroParallax::new(&products).title("The Ultimate\ndevelopment studio"));

name: Images Slider
description: Full-bleed slides cross-fade with a zoom-in entrance and a slow Ken Burns push, under a headline and call to action.
code:
ui.add(
    ImagesSlider::new()
        .textures(&slides)
        .interval(4.0)
        .title("The hero section slideshow\nnobody asked for")
        .action("Join now"),
);

name: Sticky Scroll Reveal
description: Text sections scroll past a sticky panel that swaps its content and tints the backdrop for each one.

name: Pixel Image
description: An image resolves from a few big pixels to full detail: tiles pop in, then the mosaic sharpens step by step.

name: Gemini Effect
description: Five flowing colored curves draw themselves in, converging on a central pill and fanning out again. Bind progress to scroll.

name: Tracing Beam
description: A gradient beam beside the content that fills as you scroll, with a glowing head on a spring and a dot that lights up. Scrolls itself when idle.

name: Icon Cloud
description: A sphere of icon tiles rotating in 3D, scaled and faded by depth. It drifts toward the pointer; drag to fling it.

name: Card Resize
description: A card glides between two sizes on a long smooth curve, its skeleton bars and wrapped text reflowing live as it moves.

name: Page Side By Side
description: A two-page card: picking a token drifts the list left and blurs it out while the amount page drifts in from the right, and the card eases to its new height.

name: Draggable Marquee
description: A looping strip of portrait images that cruises on its own; grab it, fling it, and it coasts on momentum with cards leaning into the speed.

name: Parallax Slider
description: An endless strip of tall frames: drag, flick or scroll and each picture drifts against the motion inside its frame; titles rise on hover once still.

name: Lens Gallery
description: An endless wall of photos seen through a fisheye: drag and fling to pan while every tile bows through the barrel lens.

name: Clothes Line
description: Pictures pegged to a sagging rope that drifts past; every card is a pendulum, so they swing and settle as the line speeds up or stops.

name: Aperture Zoom
description: A hero that starts as a small rounded window onto an image and opens like a camera aperture as you scroll, the headline's words sliding apart.

name: Zoom Reveal
description: A small pill of footage between two words opens into a full-bleed frame as the page scrolls, the words riding its edges out and a play label surfacing.

name: Marble Scroll
description: A scroll story of full-bleed pictures whose seams tear and melt into marbling as they cross the view, strongest when scrolling fast.

name: Step Path
description: Process steps joined by one dashed line hopping dot to dot; it draws in on scroll, steps fading up as it arrives, then a darker stretch travels along it.

name: Gallery Tunnel
description: An endless flight through a square wireframe tunnel lined with images and bold color panels; click or hold to accelerate, the pointer steers the view.

name: Spiral Images
description: Image cards flow along an Archimedean spiral from the edge into the center, shrinking and turning as they are drawn into the vortex; hover to slow it.

name: Coverflow Gallery
description: A 3D coverflow carousel: the active slide faces you, neighbours swing back in perspective with a floor reflection; autoplays, drag or click to move.

name: Spring Playground
description: Tune stiffness, damping and mass and watch a ball spring after the pointer (or a hopping target), with its step response plotted live.
code:
let pos: Pos2 = animate(ui, id, target, Transition::spring(stiffness, damping).mass(mass));
// any Animatable works: f32, Vec2, Pos2, Rect, Color32, Props, or your own type

name: Easing Visualizer
description: Every classic easing curve plotted with a dot riding along it, so you can feel the difference.
code:
let x = animate(ui, id, target, Transition::tween(0.6).ease(Easing::OutBack));
let k = Easing::InOutCubic.apply(progress);

name: Keyframes
description: Values passing through several stops with per-segment easing, infinite repeats, yoyo vs mirror, and repeat delays.

name: Timeline
description: A GSAP-style timeline: tweens sequenced with relative positions, labels and overlaps; play, pause, reverse, change speed or scrub.

name: Motion Box
description: A container like motion.div: enter from initial props, hover and tap states, and spring to new targets. Its children stay fully interactive.

name: Variants & Stagger
description: Switch one variant name and every child follows, staggered one after another (from the first, or from the center outward).

name: Presence
description: Content that animates out before it disappears: auto-dismissing toasts and a keyed list where items enter, exit and the rest slide into place.
code:
Presence::new(id, visible)
    .initial(Props::new().opacity(0.0).y(-12.0))
    .exit(Props::new().opacity(0.0).x(40.0))
    .show(ui, |ui| ui.label("Saved!"));

PresenceList::new(id)
    .initial(Props::new().opacity(0.0).x(-30.0))
    .exit(Props::new().opacity(0.0).scale(0.8))
    .show(ui, &items, |item| item.id, |ui, item| { ui.label(&item.name); });

name: Layout Animation
description: Items glide between layouts (grid ↔ list, shuffle) instead of jumping: FLIP-style layout animation keyed by identity.

name: Shared Element
description: A thumbnail expands into a detail view and back: the same key used in two places animates between them (layoutId).

name: Drag & Snap
description: Throw a puck around with momentum and elastic edges, snap a knob to stops along an axis, and pull a card that springs home.
code:
Draggable::new(id)
    .constraints(area)          // stay inside
    .elastic(0.35)              // rubber-band past the edges
    .momentum(true)             // glide on release, bounce back in
    .while_drag(Props::new().scale(1.12))
    .show(ui, |ui| puck(ui));

Draggable::new(id2).axis(Axis::X).snap_points([vec2(-120.0, 0.0), Vec2::ZERO, vec2(120.0, 0.0)]).show(ui, knob);

name: Reorder List
description: Drag rows to reorder them; the others slide out of the way and the dragged row lifts above them.

name: Scroll-Linked Motion
description: A progress bar tied to scroll position, parallax layers at different speeds, values mapped with transform(), and cards that animate in when scrolled into view.

name: Motion Path
description: Objects travel along a smooth path, turning to follow its tangent, with a comet trail and a staggered convoy.

name: Path Drawing
description: Any polyline drawn progressively with a gradient stroke and a glowing pen tip, then erased: like animating SVG pathLength.

name: Lanyard
description: An ID badge hanging on a strap simulated with a verlet rope. Grab it, swing it, fling it.

name: Shape Morph
description: Outlines morph smoothly between circle, square, star, heart and blob: resampled, aligned and interpolated point by point.
code:
ui.add(MorphShape::new().size(220.0));
let mid = morph_polygon(&star, &heart, t);   // any two polygons

name: Spring Chain
description: A follow-the-leader chain of springs: each dot chases the one in front, making whippy trails behind the pointer.

name: Flying Posters
description: Posters ride a curved 3D drum: they swell as they pass the middle and tilt away over the top. Scroll or drag to fly.

name: 3D Viewport
description: The software 3D engine: meshes, materials (smooth, flat, toon, matcap, normal, wireframe, glow), lights, shadows, grid and 3D text, depth-sorted into egui meshes. Drag to orbit.

name: Model Viewer
description: A lit 3D model floating over a soft shadow. Drag to orbit with inertia, pinch or ctrl+scroll to zoom; switch models, materials and the wireframe overlay.

name: Particle Morph
description: Thousands of glowing points morph between a sphere, torus, wave, cube, helix and galaxy with a staggered, eased transition. The pointer pushes particles away; drag to orbit.

name: Wave Terrain
description: An endless noise landscape the camera flies over: synthwave neon grid with a striped sun, a glowing wireframe, or flat-shaded low-poly hills.

name: Tilt Cubes
description: A grid of 3D cubes that tilt to face the pointer; click to send a ripple through the grid. Wanders and ripples on its own when idle.

name: 3D Card Carousel
description: A ring of gradient cards spinning in 3D with perspective text and a glossy floor reflection. Drag sideways to spin it with inertia.

name: 3D Flip Card
description: Cards that flip over in 3D with a springy overshoot when clicked and tilt towards the pointer while hovered.

name: Globe 3D
description: A true-3D lit globe: continents as thousands of dots, glowing arcs with comets between cities, pulsing markers, a graticule and an atmosphere halo. Drag to spin.

name: Galaxy
description: A spiral galaxy of thousands of twinkling stars with differential rotation, nebula dust and a glowing core; the camera swoops through it on a cinematic path.

name: Warp Starfield
description: Fly forward through a true-3D field of streaking stars. Hover to steer, press and hold to jump to warp speed.

name: Floating Shapes Hero
description: Glossy gradient primitives float and spin in front of and behind a 3D headline, with pointer parallax: a Spline-style hero section.
code: ui.add(FloatingShapes::new("Build in 3D", "Pure Rust. No GPU pipeline. Just egui.").height(380.0));

name: Glow Knot
description: A torus knot as glowing neon: a bright core line wrapped in layered bloom, light pulses racing along it and a faint wireframe tube. Drag to orbit.

name: Voxel Text
description: Text built from glossy 3D voxel cubes (a tiny pixel font) rippling in a wave, swaying, and periodically bursting apart and snapping back together.

name: 3D Bar Chart
description: Data columns in a 3D grid that grow in with a staggered spring. Hover a bar to read it, drag to orbit, double-click to replay.

name: DNA Helix
description: A rotating double helix of glossy spheres joined by colored base-pair rungs, fading into depth. Drag to orbit.

name: Puzzle Cube
description: A 3x3x3 twisty puzzle cube that scrambles itself with smooth eased face turns. Drag to orbit.

name: 3D Marquee
description: A tilted perspective wall of cards whose columns scroll in alternating directions and fade out towards the edges.

name: Solar System
description: A glowing sun with planets lit from the sun (real day and night sides) on orbit rings, a ringed giant and an orbiting moon. Drag to orbit, hover planets for names.

name: Prism Beam
description: A glass prism that refracts a white beam into a rainbow fan with real Snell's law; drag to aim the light and watch the spectrum sweep.

name: Crumple Carousel
description: Posters in a row where only the focused one lies flat; neighbours crinkle and the outer ones are balled up, smoothing out as they reach the middle.

name: Pleated Strip
description: An endless column of posters joined by paper pleats and rolled round a drum; scrolling fast throws the folds open, at rest they close and the nearest poster centres.

name: DNA Carousel
description: Pictures wound onto two opposing helix strands that drift past, the far ones blurred and colour-fringed like a lens edge.

name: Arc Carousel
description: Cards riding a very large circle, the focused one upright at the apex and the rest tilted tangent to the curve.
code:
let items = vec![ArcItem::new("Old Quarter", "Lanes that bend toward the river."), /* ... */];
ui.add(ArcCarousel::new(&items).curve(1.0).autoplay(2.8));

name: Wave Gallery
description: An endless ribbon of glossy cards bent into a wave in depth, titles printed into the surface, far cards sinking into fog.

name: Image Tunnel
description: An endless 3D corridor with pictures on all four walls and a fine wireframe gliding toward you; click to pause, hold to rush.

name: Spiral Slider
description: Curved picture panels wound onto a helix that screws along its own track, the far side frosted through the gaps.

name: Particle Globe
description: Continents drawn as thousands of points on a slowly rotating sphere; drag to spin it and it keeps its momentum.

name: Particle Saturn
description: A point-cloud ringed planet: a Fibonacci-sphere body inside wide particle rings with dark divisions; inner rings orbit faster. Drag to spin with inertia.

name: Cosmic Orb
description: A glass sphere holding a turning galaxy: drifting nebula, twinkling stars, a lensed rim with chromatic fringes. It leans toward the pointer.

name: Single Glass Keyboard
description: A single glass keycap refracting orange, magenta and blue studio light into rainbow fringes; it floats, tilts after the pointer and presses on click.

name: Cobalt Sprite
description: A blue sprite with pill eyes inside a thick glass capsule, clear above and frosted below; it watches the pointer, bobs and blinks.

name: Corolla Gleam
description: A crown of thick iridescent glass slabs standing in a ring: it turns, breathes and leans toward the pointer while thin-film colors slide across the glass.

name: Cylinder Carousel
description: Round artworks wrapped around a drum: drag to roll it and they swing round, swelling, narrowing and dimming with the angle before snapping into place.

name: Spinners
description: Eighteen loader styles in one widget: rings, arcs, dots, bars, pulses, orbits, waves, grids, helixes and more.

name: Progress Ring
description: Circular progress with a centered value, sub-label, gradient arcs and an indeterminate spin.

name: Multi Step Loader
description: An overlay listing the steps of a long task; each checks off in turn while the current one is highlighted and centered.

name: Button
description: Six variants, three sizes, icons, icon-only and loading states, with a springy press.

name: Segmented Control
description: A muted track with a raised thumb that springs between options.

name: Input

name: Pill Nav

name: Staggered Menu

name: Infinite Menu

name: Tabs
description: Tab strips whose active indicator glides between tabs on a spring: segmented, underline and pill styles.

name: Navbar

name: Stepper
description: A wizard header: numbered steps joined by a line that fills as you advance, check marks for completed steps and a pulsing ring on the current one.

name: Command Palette
description: A ⌘K / Ctrl+K palette: modal search with grouped fuzzy results, a gliding highlight and full keyboard navigation.

name: Animated Link
description: Text links with animated hover treatments: an underline that draws in and leaves the other way, a highlighter sweep, and an underlined link with a turning arrow.

name: Table of Contents

name: Section Index
description: Contacts with sticky headers and an A-Z bar: scrub it and the letters swell like a dock while a bubble pops out beside the finger.

let names = ["Aaron Price", "Abby Chen", "Ben Carter", "Carla Diaz"];
ui.add(SectionIndex::new(&names).title("Contacts").magnify(60.0));

name: Action Bar Sheet
description: Command menus that collapse into a ⋯ drawer on phones: rows slide sideways into each menu's items, and the drawer drags and flicks away.

name: Trail Nav
description: A navigation stack with breadcrumbs and a back link: pages slide with parallax, swipe from the edge to pop interactively, hold Back for the history.

name: Glass Tabs
description: A tab switch whose selection is a thick liquid-glass lens that magnifies the track, squeezes in flight and wobbles as it lands.

name: Morph Navbar
description: A dark pill nav that springs open into its own dropdown, one shell resizing between a picture reel, an accordion and a link list.

name: Shared Layout Background

name: Bounce Sidebar
description: Sidebar links with a dot that hops to the one you pick: it leaps out in an arc, stretches in flight and lands with a squash.

name: Link Preview
description: Hovering a link springs a preview card up from the text; it leans toward the pointer.

name: Hero Video Dialog
description: A video thumbnail with a pulsing glass play button that opens an animated player dialog.

name: Dialog
description: A modal card that springs in from 95% scale over a fading backdrop. Closes on Escape, the X or a backdrop click.

name: Alert Dialog
description: A blocking confirmation with Cancel / Continue actions and an optional destructive style.

name: Sheet / Drawer
description: A panel that slides in on a spring from any edge over a dimmed backdrop; bottom sheets get a grab handle.

Sheet::new(&mut open, "Edit profile")

name: Toast (Sonner)
description: Stacked toasts that fan out on hover, auto-dismiss with a progress line, swipe away, and come in success / error / info / warning / loading flavours.

name: Tooltip
description: A small inverted label that fades and scales in next to a widget after a hover delay, with an arrow; flips when out of room.

name: Dropdown Menu
description: Menus with icons, shortcuts, labels, separators, checkbox / radio items and submenus; a highlight glides between rows and the keyboard works (↑ ↓ Enter → ← Esc).

name: Spotlight Tour
description: A guided onboarding tour: the page dims except a glowing cut-out that glides between targets, with a step card, progress dots and Back / Next.

name: Dynamic Island
description: A black pill that morphs between idle, compact status, call, media player and notification layouts with springy resizing and cross-faded content.

name: Sticky Banner
description: A dismissible announcement bar with a flowing gradient; closing slides it up and the page content follows.
code:
ui.add(StickyBanner::new(&mut open, "glowkit 1.0 is out! 30 new components.")

name: Coach Tip
description: Feature tips that pop out of their arrow on a spring; drag one and it rubber-bands, fling it and it flies off; then the next tip in the group appears.

name: Top Banner
description: Banners drop in from the top on a spring and queue one at a time; grab one to pause it, stretch it down against rubber, or flick it up to dismiss.

name: Undo Bar
description: Delete a note and it folds away while a pill with a countdown ring rises; Undo unfolds it back, swipe the pill down to commit.

let mut notes = vec![TouchRow::new("Groceries", "Milk, eggs, bread")];
ui.add(UndoBar::new(&mut notes).timeout(5.0).bounce(35.0));

name: Confirm Sheet
description: A confirmation that rises as an action sheet on phones (drag it down to dismiss, push it up against rubber) and pops as an alert on wide screens.

name: Cookie Frog
description: A cookie banner with a clay frog: switch a category on and its cookie pops out, the tongue snaps it from the air, and a full set earns a smile and a crown.

name: Morphing Modal
description: A button that becomes its own sheet; picking a row re-measures the sheet, its height easing to the new page as the content slides across.

name: Center Morph Modal
description: A dialog that unfolds from the middle: the button flattens into a bright seam, stretches sideways, then opens along the crease as the content rises in.

let go = CenterMorphModal::new("Open modal")

    .action("Explore Pro")
    .show(ui);

name: Feedback Widget
description: A corner chat button that springs open into the feedback form, then shrinks into a thank-you pill with a drawn check before folding back.

name: Notification Stack
description: Notifications stacked like a deck over a count badge; press and they fan down into a full list as the container grows around them.

name: Notification Center
description: An activity inbox with sliding filter tabs and counts, grouped timeline cards with avatars or badges, unread dots, inline actions, mark-all-read and an empty state.
code:
let mut inbox = vec![BoardNotice::mention("LK", "Livia mentioned you", "Can you review this?", "2m").actions(&["Reply"])];
ui.add(BoardNotifications::new(&mut inbox));

name: Avatar & Avatar Group
description: Initial avatars with name-derived gradients, presence dots, sizes and overlapping groups that lift on hover.

name: Data Table
description: Sortable columns with an animated indicator, row hover, selection with select-all, rich cells and pagination.

name: Timeline
description: A vertical timeline whose connector fills up to the current event, which pulses softly.

name: Stat Card
description: KPI cards whose values count up, with colored delta pills and sparklines that draw themselves in.

name: Empty State
description: A friendly placeholder with a fanned stack of icon tiles that spreads on hover, copy and actions.

name: Tree View
description: A file-explorer tree with guides, rotating chevrons, animated expand / collapse and selection.

name: Code Block
description: Syntax-highlighted code with line numbers, highlighted lines, a file header and a copy button.

name: Accordion
description: Stacked sections that expand with animated height, a rotating chevron and hover underline.

Accordion::new("faq")

    .show(ui);

name: Resizable
description: Horizontal and vertical split panels with draggable grip handles, min/max sizes and nested groups. Double-click a handle to even it out.

name: Globe
description: A rotating dotted globe with rim glow, pulsing markers and arcs that fly between cities. Drag to spin it.

description: Signed-in devices: sign one out and its row spins then folds away; sign out the rest and they fold one after another; restore unfolds them.

name: Meter
description: Quota meters that fill with a spring and shift from blue to amber to red as the limit nears, with a breathing glow when critical.

description: Multi-series lines that draw in, with a snapping crosshair tooltip, clickable legend, glow, gradient and dashed variants.

description: Bars that grow in with a stagger: grouped, stacked, horizontal, negative values, value labels, hover highlight and animated striped fills.

description: Slices sweep in; the hovered slice pops out; donuts show a center total that follows the hovered slice; padding, labels and rounded ends.

description: Tiny line, area and bar charts for tables and cards.

name: Heatmap

name: Funnel Chart
description: Conversion stages as centered bars joined by smooth tapered bands, with drop-off and share of total.

name: Bar List & Progress List
description: Ranked horizontal bars with labels inside and values on the right, plus labelled progress bars against targets.

name: Treemap
description: A squarified treemap whose tiles scale in by size, with labels that appear when they fit.

name: Candlestick Chart
description: OHLC candles growing from their midpoints, with a price-tagged crosshair and an OHLC tooltip.

name: Combo Chart
description: Columns and a glowing line sharing categories, optionally on two y axes.

description: KPI cards with a counting number, a colored delta badge and a sparkline.

description: A status tracker of colored blocks with tooltips (uptime), and circular progress rings.
